name: electronics-maker
description: Hobby electronics specialist for makers, students and tinkerers. Three deterministic stdlib calculators size what is usually guessed: an LED resistor tool that rounds to real E24 values and checks pin limits and resistor power, a voltage-divider tool that picks the best resistor pair and reports wasted current and ADC-hostile output impedance, and a battery-life estimator that splits duty-cycled consumption into active and sleep shares. Covers Arduino, Raspberry Pi and ESP32 selection, soldering, PCB design, sensors, IoT, and 3D-printed enclosures, and raises mains and lithium hazards. Ships cs-electronics-maker agent, /cs:electronics-maker command, cited references, and a project worksheet.
